cardEffects:
While this card is revealed from your deck, this card is also treated as level 6.
When this card would be played from the hand, by returning 1 [Apocalymon] from your trash to the bottom of the deck, reduce the play cost by 3.
[On Deletion] If deleted by an effect, you may play 1 [Gulfmon] or 1 level 6 Digimon with the [Dark Masters] trait from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
inheritedEffect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 5 or lower card with [Dark Masters] in its text from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
name: Mephistomon

rulings.answer: This effect means that this card is also treated as a level 6 card while it's flipped over from the deck by a "reveal cards from the deck" effect.  If the effect is an effect such as "add 1 level 6 Digimon card from the revealed cards," you can use that effect to add this card to the hand.
rulings.question: What does this card's "while this card is revealed from your deck, this card is also treated as level 6" mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  The effect reads "also treated as level 6," therefore this card can be treated as both level 5 and level 6, so you can add 2 copies to your hand.
rulings.question: If I reveal 2 copies of this card using BT3-051 [Dokugumon]'s [On Play] effect, can I add both copies to my hand?

rulings.answer: No, it doesn’t activate. This Digimon is deleted by the rules, not the DP-reducing effect. Therefore, it doesn't meet the "if deleted by an effect" condition.
rulings.question: Does the "if deleted by an effect" effect activate when this Digimon's DP becomes 0 and is deleted due to a DP-reducing effect?

rulings.answer: This effect targets a level 5 or lower card with [Dark Masters] in its text from your trash.  This card's inherited effect has been changed to "[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 5 or lower card with [Dark Masters] in its text from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn."    Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.
